title: gladiolus segetum f. sterilis
intro: Gladiolus segetum f. sterilis, commonly known as sterile corn lily or wild gladiolus, is a species of flowering plant in the family Iridaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation and act as an anti-diarrheal agent. The therapeutic actions of Gladiolus segetum f. sterilis include its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and reduce pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include steroidal glycosides, flavonoids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
